claim_adjudications.span: General Insurance adjusted pre-tax income, underwriting income and adjusted after-tax income attributable to common shareholders all moved higher sequentially, and the reported General Insurance combined ratio improved
the accident-year adjusted measures, which were flat to marginally better

GAAP net income attributable to common shareholders and GAAP income from continuing operations both fell sharply sequentially, and consolidated reported net investment income fell while the APTI-basis investment income rose
General Insurance gross and net premiums written also declined sequentially
the thesis remains on hold pending a fuller reconciliation of GAAP to adjusted results and the investment-income basis difference

notes: Separates segment and consolidated figures, reported and adjusted bases, and reported versus accident-year combined ratios. Does not turn the premium decline or investment-income gap into a source-unsupported cause. Missing reconciliation leads to a correctly blocked state.
